subject: Saturday trailhead meetup
text: Event is Saturday, 10 a.m., at the east trailhead, not the north lot. Bring layers because wind by the river gets sharp by noon. If it rains, we move to the barn, right after the first fence. Carpooling helps; only eight spots near the gate. I am bringing coffee, donuts, and a spare first aid kit. Message me by Thursday if anyone cannot fit into your car; I will adjust signups and send an updated map. Wear closed shoes for safety. That is all for now.
